bitcoin_core.why: latest tagged release at the time the harness was written; the coin-selection algorithms are used as-is, with only the instrumentation patch in patches/ applied

coin_select.describes: PR #73: depth-first branch and bound, the changeless metrics removed, aggregate queries moved onto SelectionView
coin_select.why: the ancestor-aware selection work this benchmark exists to measure, now traversed depth-first instead of from a priority queue; `Changeless` and `LowestFeeChangeless` are gone with it, so there is no changeless metric left to pit against Core's SelectCoinsBnB and the harness runs the wallet track alone
